subject: PrivInfra conformance audit: Terraform / Helm / Ansible module review kickoff
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Miller <jmiller@acme-financial.com>, acme-infra-team@acme-financial.com
Cc: irene_choi@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai, mina_haddad@redwood.ai, partners@solstice-cloud.com
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: PrivInfra conformance audit: Terraform / Helm / Ansible module review kickoff

Hi team —

Thanks for agreeing to the conformance audit. Per our call last week, Redwood will perform a short, focused review of the private-deploy IaC modules that will run in Acme's VPC/on-prem footprint. Goal: confirm CI gating, secrets handling, DR/rollback readiness, and network zoning before we proceed to the pilot cluster.

Attached is a lightweight checklist we intend to use as the baseline (priv-iac-checklist.xlsx). Please:
- Confirm the list of module owners and a single point-of-contact for each module by EOD Thursday.
- Share any compliance evidence that should be exempted (e.g., vendor-managed firmware attestations).
- If you have a preferred time for the technical walkthrough next week, add availability to the shared slot in the Confluence page.

High-level scope:
- Terraform: VPC + subnets + route tables + NCC rules
- Helm: chart values that touch egress, PSPs, and service meshes
- Ansible: bootstrapping nodes, kubelet config, and HSM/KMS integration scripts

I'll coordinate the merge-request sweep with irene and jonas. 

Thanks —
Laura Bennett
VP, Platform Ops
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: priv-iac-checklist.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Jordan Miller <jmiller@acme-financial.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: acme-infra-team@acme-financial.com, irene_choi@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 10:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: PrivInfra conformance audit: Terraform / Helm / Ansible module review kickoff

Laura —

Appreciate the clear scope. We're aligned on owners for networking and nodes but will need to confirm the Helm chart stewards (looks like two teams share those charts right now). I'll get a roster to you by Wednesday EOD.

Quick note: Acme's procurement requires us to share an inventory of vendor-signed binaries that run on air-gapped hosts; that may be a short delay for the Ansible package verification. Will loop Solstice on that.

Jordan
Senior Infrastructure Manager, Acme Financial
jmiller@acme-financial.com

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Jordan Miller <jmiller@acme-financial.com>
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.ai, mina_haddad@redwood.ai, partners@solstice-cloud.com
Date: Wed, 02 Dec 2026 15:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: PrivInfra conformance audit: Terraform / Helm / Ansible module review kickoff

Thanks Laura — looping in the technical plan. I've started a quick MR sweep and flagged the following as higher-risk items (link below):

- Terraform: open security group with 0.0.0.0/0 on management subnet (tf/modules/network/main.tf:line 142)
- Helm: chart 'logging-agent' has hostPath mounts without SELinux labels (charts/logging/values.yaml)
- Ansible: bootstrap role writes keys to /tmp during an early play (roles/bootstrap/tasks/main.yml)

Proposed next steps:
1) Schedule a 60-minute walkthrough to show the MR diffs and remediation suggestions (I put proposed times on the Confluence page).
2) Jonas and I will author a short CI gates proposal (ci-gates-proposal.md) that enforces: terraform fmt + tflint in the merge pipeline, helm chartlint + policy-check, and Ansible syntax + secret-detection.
3) For air-gapped binary inventory: Solstice, can you confirm whether you provide signed artifacts and an SLS manifest?

Link: https://gitlab.redwood.ai/privinfra/merge_requests/452

I attached the initial CI gates doc draft.

Thanks,
Irene Choi
Sr. Infrastructure Engineer, Redwood Inference

[Attachment: ci-gates-proposal.md (text)]

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Jordan Miller <jmiller@acme-financial.com>
Cc: mina_haddad@redwood.ai, partners@solstice-cloud.com
Date: Thu, 03 Dec 2026 11:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: PrivInfra conformance audit: Terraform / Helm / Ansible module review kickoff

+1 to Irene's list — I ran a quick dependency scan and added a couple of points inline on MR 452. Two items I'd like owners to accept explicitly before the pilot:

- CI gating must include a live-network smoke test that runs in a non-prod VPC (failure here should block promotion).
- We require signed chart artifacts; unsigned uploads to the chart registry should trigger a policy-failure.

On the smoke-test: suggested approach is a short plan that creates resources with ttl=1h and runs connectivity checks to critical services only (no external egress). If owners accept, we can land a lightweight job in the GitLab pipelines.

Jonas Weber
Platform Reliability Lead, Redwood Inference

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>

Cc: partners@solstice-cloud.com
Date: Thu, 04 Dec 2026 16:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: PrivInfra conformance audit: Terraform / Helm / Ansible module review kickoff

Thanks everyone — quick confirmations and proposed runbook snippet below.

Confirmations:
- Owners roster: Jordan (Acme-networking), @acme-helm-team (chart steward), Solstice (signed artifacts) — please finalize on Confluence by tomorrow.
- CI gates: accepted in principle. I'll shepherd the test job templates and the secret-detection hook.
- Air-gapped packages: Solstice to provide SLS manifest by Friday to unblock Ansible verification.

Runbook snippet (for rollback):
1) Trigger pipeline rollback job: gitlab pipeline/rollback -> deploy previous tagged release (tagged_releases/privinfra/).
2) Run network isolation verification (script: scripts/verify-no-egress.sh).
3) If node re-imaging required, follow roles/bootstrap/rollback.md and rotate node keys via KMS.

I'll attach the short rollback playbook for your review. Once Solstice confirms artifacts and Acme posts the roster, we'll schedule the MR walkthrough.

Mina Haddad
Manager, Deployment Assurance, Redwood Inference

[Attachment: rollback-playbook.md (text)]
